title: Comparative clinicoradiologic research study of the tunnel plastics of multiple gingival recessions with Autograft and Xenogen Collagen matrix
authors: Vedyaeva AP, Brailovskaya TV, Tarasenko SV, Bulkina NV, Garibian EA, Nebylitsin IV. J. Adv. Pharm. Educ. Res. 2020 Oct-Dec;10(4),99. E-ISSN: 2249-3379.
supports: Clinical study from the botiss mucoderm (porcine collagen soft-tissue matrix) literature list — the product featured in it, which is not the same as the study being about the product, so check the design and the comparator before citing it as product evidence. Authors' conclusion, verbatim: “The use of the Mucoderm collagen matrix showed statistically significant clinicoradiologic results for class 2 gingival recession coverage for the thin mucous phenotype at long-term dates compared to the “gold standard” of autograft gingival surgery. 34” This records what the paper says, not what a rep may say: the sales wording still has to pass the claim tiers, and a study in one indication licenses nothing in another.
